what_it_does: This paper presents a compact, ultra-low-power neural network accelerator for denoising audio on small wearable devices and Internet-of-Things sensors. The chip uses a convolutional encoder-decoder network compressed with reduced-precision arithmetic (fewer bits per number) to achieve real-time noise removal in just 0.75 square millimeters of silicon area while consuming only 407 microwatts. The specialized hardware routing minimizes repeated memory transfers.
